title: Limiting API calls

concepts.description: A token bucket refills at a steady rate up to a cap, so it allows short bursts while enforcing an average rate.
concepts.context: refills tokens by elapsed time up to CAP in allow()

concepts.description: State held in one process is not shared between instances, so a per-process limit multiplies by the number of instances.
concepts.context: the buckets live in a Map inside one server process
